editable SVG
In the app
every platform - the pay button is where they differ

g.text: SimpleX is built by people who believe private
messaging should not depend on advertising.
A badge helps pay for it.
Why SimpleX is built this way

svg.text: 1. Where it starts
Both actions already exist in the shipped view.
'Redeem badge code' is the only route to a badge on
iOS and the Play build until store evidence is verified,
so it is not a secondary action there - it is the path.

g.text: Two levels. Both remove the file size limit;
Perks are app constants, not catalog data - the

svg.text: 2. Choose your level
Prices come from CRBadgeCatalog, never from the store
products - one source, so the app and the site cannot
disagree. A tier with no active price renders disabled
rather than hidden.

g.text: Prepaid months. Nothing renews by itself.
3 months is 2x the monthly price, 12 months is 6x.
The saving shown is against the undiscounted total
and is never sent anywhere - the server computes

svg.text: 3. How long
The button is the only platform difference in this whole
band. Desktop and Android foss get 'Continue in browser'.
iOS and Play get 'Redeem badge code' and never link out,
because both stores reject steering to outside purchase.

g.text: Checkout happens in your browser. Nothing is

svg.text: 4. Only where there is a choice
Desktop and Android foss only. The screen exists because
those builds have three methods; the store builds have
none and never reach it. The choice is a hint - the site
asks again if the parameter is unusable.

g.text: Paste the code from your receipt.
This code has already been used
Formats as you type and folds I/L to 1 and O to 0,
matching the service's own normalisation - so a code
read off a screen cannot fail on ambiguity alone.

svg.text: 5. Redeeming
One inline message per error the service can return:
invalid, used, expired, rate limited. Anything else shows
the service's own text rather than a blank screen. The
same code can be retried - redemption is idempotent.

g.text: Prepaid months have no billing date. The badge is
reissued each month from the balance you already
paid for, and simply ends when it runs out.

svg.text: 6. After redeeming
'Ends', never 'renews' - nothing recurs, and the copy
must not imply it does. The date is the paid-through
date computed from the ledger balance, not the
credential's expiry, which is a week-aligned internal.
Continue in browser
opens the site with tier, months and method already chosen
On the web
badges.simplex.chat - one question per screen, no framework
7. The site, prefilled
Arrives with ?tier=legend&months=12&pay=xmr from the app,
so every answered question is skipped. An unknown or
unpriced parameter is ignored and its screen asked -
the app may be older than the catalog.
8. How long
Every figure here comes from GET /api/catalog, which
serves the same totals the RPC catalog gives the app.
The browser formats minor units; it never multiplies
a price by a month count.

g.text: How would you like to pay?

svg.text: 9. Method
A method whose provider is not configured is refused at
checkout with provider_unavailable, not hidden here -
so a misconfigured deployment fails loudly rather than
quietly offering less.

g.text: You will be shown an address and a QR code. The badge
code appears here once the payment confirms.

svg.text: 10. One request, server-priced
POST /api/checkout sends priceId, offerId and method -
never an amount, never a badge type. Both are derived
server-side from the ids, so a tampered request cannot
buy a Legend badge at a Supporter price.

g.text: Waiting for the payment to confirm
Leave this page open, or bookmark it - the address and
the countdown are both on this URL. If the invoice
expires before it confirms, you are offered a new one.

svg.text: 11. Paying in crypto
Five states behind one screen: invoiced, pending, paid,
expired, failed. An expired invoice that was underpaid
shows what arrived and the reference - the shortfall is
meaningless once the rate window has closed.

g.text: scan to carry it to your phone
SimpleX -> Settings -> Supporter perks -> Redeem code
This is the only place the code is shown.
This page keeps working until 23 September, and stops
as soon as the code is redeemed. The link is the code.

svg.text: 12. The code, once
The code is derived from the order id, not stored - so a
reload recomputes it while only its hash is ever at rest.
Disclosure stops at redemption, at revocation, or 30 days
after settlement, whichever comes first.
the code goes back to screen 5
the only thing that crosses from the site to the app

Design document. Screens are drawn in the app's iOS idiom and in the site's own simple layout; they are not screenshots. What is built today: the service schema, the pricing catalog, the ledger, code derivation and classification, credential signing, and the RPC dispatcher.

What is design, not yet built: every screen above, the web listener and its endpoints, both payment providers, and the client redeem path. Store purchase is removed on iOS and Play for the duration of this plan - store evidence is not verified, so a store purchase would charge for a badge that is never issued.
